entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... I think I need to return something. I'm a little overwhelmed by the website and I'm not sure what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Michael Chen. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Michael. I see your order here for the Road Cycling Shoes. One moment while I review this... Okay, I see they were delivered 38 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

I... I don't really know. I tried to install the cleats, and I just couldn't get them right. I went for one short ride and they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. The policy online was so confusing. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. Let me just check our return policy for you... Okay, I see here that you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can still return them?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 10 days, I can process this return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any postal service location.
Wow, that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Diana. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Michael. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
